notes: Address confirmed via embedded session.store object matching batch exactly (5855 Mission Gorge Rd, San Diego). Prices read from the location's own ordering platform (Recurve, store id 767), linked from the restaurant's own site's San Diego location page. 117 of 124 dishes read directly from flat per-item price/matrix_price fields. 7 named specialty 18" pizzas (Fabulous Four, Meat Mania, Classic Combo, Veggie, Hawaiian, Buffalo Chicken, Pesto Grilled Chicken) do not carry a standalone total price in the data; their price was reconstructed as base 18" cheese pizza price ($26.95) plus the specialty's own topping-surcharge value from the matching category nav's level_price map, cross-validated by requiring the item's internal menu_level to match the size stated in its name (one item, '18" White Pizza', failed this check due to a mismatched menu_level and was dropped rather than guessed). Excluded ~48 items as catering bulk/party-tray portions (half/full trays, N-sandwich multipacks, jarred/bottled sauces, wire racks) per adjunct rule. Reconstructed specialty-pizza prices are noted per-dish; all fell in a tight, internally consistent $38.95-$40.95 band supporting the reconstruction.
